description: This file defines static class AssetFlows which encapsulates various create, read, update, query, and delete operations for assets within the DataAssetBackend project. It includes request and result record types, methods for asset management, and detailed documentation comments explaining each function's purpose and side effects.

classes.name: AssetFlows
classes.description: A static class providing orchestrated flow methods for asset CRUD operations and related request/response types.

methods.name: CreateAssetAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset in the database via the repository, logging progress and returning the created asset details.

methods.name: GetAssetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by ID, excluding soft-deleted records, and logs the process.

methods.name: UpdateAssetAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset by ID, ensuring immutability of certain fields, with logging.

methods.name: QueryAssetsAsync
methods.description: Queries assets with optional filters, returning a list of assets and logging the operation.

methods.name: DeleteAssetAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on an asset and its dependent rows within a transaction, logging the operation.
